# hoodscanR: Cellular neighborhoods scanning from spatial transcriptomics data in R ![](reference/figures/hoodscanR_sticker.png)

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/DavisLaboratory/hoodscanR/workflows/R-CMD-check-bioc/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DavisLaboratory/hoodscanR/actions)
[![Coverage
status](https://codecov.io/gh/DavisLaboratory/hoodscanR/branch/devel/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/DavisLaboratory/hoodscanR?branch=devel)

Install released version from Bioconductor

    if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("BiocManager")

    BiocManager::install("hoodscanR")

Install development version from GitHub

    library(devtools)
    devtools::install_github("DavisLaboratory/hoodscanR")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calcMetrics()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/calcMetrics.md)
  : Calculate metrics for probability matrix
- [`clustByHood()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/clustByHood.md)
  : Cluster the probability matrix with K-means
- [`findNearCells()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/findNearCells.md)
  : Find the k-th nearest cells for each cell
- [`mergeByGroup()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/mergeByGroup.md)
  : Merge probability matrix based on annotations
- [`mergeHoodSpe()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/mergeHoodSpe.md)
  : Merge probability matrix into SpatialExperiment object.
- [`perplexityPermute()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/perplexityPermute.md)
  : Compute p-value for perplexity via permutation
- [`plotColocal()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/plotColocal.md)
  : Plot heatmap for neighbourhood analysis
- [`plotHoodMat()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/plotHoodMat.md)
  : Plot probability matrix as a heatmap
- [`plotProbDist()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/plotProbDist.md)
  : Plot probability distribution
- [`plotTissue()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/plotTissue.md)
  : Plot cells based on cell position on tissue.
- [`readHoodData()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/readHoodData.md)
  : Read cellular position and annotation data into a list object.
- [`scanHoods()`](https://davislaboratory.github.io/hoodscanR/reference/scanHoods.md)
  : Scan cellular neighbourhoods.
